title: Hono & Bun Starter Kit
subtitle: High-Performance RESTful Todo API & Reactive Monolith
summary: Full-stack starter kit unifying Bun runtime, Hono.js, and native SQLite (bun:sqlite) with 100% automated test coverage and millisecond latency.
overview: The Hono & Bun Starter Kit was designed to eliminate stack bloat and setup friction by providing a cohesive, blisteringly fast, and scale-ready full-stack application. Bun serves as both high-velocity JavaScript runtime and native SQLite database engine (bun:sqlite), while Hono.js orchestrates HTTP endpoints with near-zero latency.
responsibilities: Designed the request lifecycle unifying static file delivery and REST endpoints within a single Bun process.
Integrated lightweight relational persistence with native C-level bun:sqlite without bulky ORM dependencies.
Built a 100% automated, isolated test suite using bun:test covering all happy and edge-case CRUD flows.
Implemented a reactive, build-step-free frontend UI using Vanilla JS and Tailwind CSS.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Achieving a modern, reactive user experience without the build overhead of heavy frontend frameworks.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Leveraged asynchronous Vanilla JS to update the DOM directly based on Hono.js JSON responses.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Preventing state leakage and data contamination between automated test executions.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Implemented test lifecycle hooks in bun:test to rebuild and clean the SQLite schema in isolation before each test cycle.
